draft.body:
CASE-1095 (PT-63390, adalimumab-adaz 40 mg q2w for RA, Dr. Priya Natarajan, Lakeside Arthritis Center).

Bluepeak Commercial denied on 2026-10-17: member coverage not active on date of service. The insurance on file dates from 2025 intake.

The patient told Lee W. on 10/17 that a new job brought new Northwind coverage from 10/01, and will send a card photo. This is unverified.

Please:
1. Run Bluepeak eligibility and confirm the termination date.
2. On receipt of the card, run Northwind eligibility and capture member ID, group and effective date.
3. Confirm the specialty pharmacy benefit for adalimumab under Northwind.

Once confirmed, we will restart the PA with Northwind using the existing documentation (RA dx by rheumatologist, MTX 20 mg/wk 12/2025 to 04/2026 inadequate). The Bluepeak window closes 2026-11-16, so the deadline is not at risk.

operator_summary.headline: Reverify benefits and confirm the new Northwind coverage
why: Bluepeak denied because coverage was not active on the service date.
Patient reports switching to Northwind insurance on October 1.
No escalation needed; about four weeks remain in the window.
then: Follow up with the patient for the Northwind card photo.
Pull Northwind's adalimumab policy once coverage is confirmed.
Restart the prior auth with Northwind using existing records.
